BDI.note: Register of payment institutions; says nothing on e-procurement.

facts.fact: The Banque de la Republique du Burundi publishes its register of payment institutions, listing twelve active ones (eight international remitters, three e-money issuers, one aggregator) with licence numbers and licence withdrawals for two e-money issuers.

BDI.note: Register only; no consumer rules or complaints body stated.
Lists international money transfer firms but states no digital corridor in service.
Nothing on government payments to people.

facts.fact: The central bank's register shows licensed payment institutions that are not banks, including e-money issuers Lumicash, Ecocash and Cashtel, with licence numbers and approval dates.

BDI.note: The law itself is not named or stated.

facts.fact: The central bank lists three active e-money issuing payment institutions, Lumicash, Ecocash and Cashtel, as at 9 February 2026.

BDI.note: Nothing on tax or fee payment.
